seo.description: Licensed massage serving Otisville, NY — about 12 min from Brooklyn via Route 211 West. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: Otisville is a short twelve-minute hop east on Route 211. Whether you're driving in from the hamlet for foot reflexology after a long shift or a deep-tissue session on the weekend, we keep things simple, transparent, and easy to book.
